title: Archive, restore and purge a whole board through kanbus-api
description: Ryan decided 2026-10-20 (via Chatticus): archive then purge. When a Chatticus bot is deleted, Chatticus archives its board; the board is purged after a retention period (30 days for Chatticus); an owner may ask for immediate removal (archive then purge). Routes, all for principals holding a provisioning grant on the board, all idempotent by X-Operation-Id and journaled (resumable): POST /{tenant}/{project}/api/board/archive (sets an archive marker in control state outside the canonical prefix, with archived_at and purge_after = archived_at + KANBUS_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_DAYS, a required deployment setting); POST /{tenant}/{project}/api/board/restore (clears the marker; 409 if not archived or already purged); DELETE /{tenant}/{project}/api/board (purge: only when archived, else 409 board_not_archived; removes canonical objects, events, receipts and catalog rows of that scope only, never other scopes). While archived: every issue and config route returns 404 not_found for non-provisioning principals (same body as an absent board, revealing nothing); provisioning principals may still GET config, issues and events; all writes return 409 board_archived. A scheduled sweeper (Lambda on a schedule, part of the deployable artifact kbs-4818904b) purges boards whose purge_after has passed, finding them through an archive index in control state, not by listing tenants. Spec first in services/kanbus-api/features.

comments.text: Merged in PR #512 (archive, restore, purge via virtuus-store 0.2.0 purge_scope, archive index in reserved _kanbus scope, kanbus-api-sweeper) and deployed by @kanbus/cdk 0.2.0 (PR #513: required archiveRetentionDays, sweeper Lambda with reserved concurrency 1, hourly schedule).
